sources.snippet: Limitations Encoder-Only: BalBERT is a 278M parameter encoder model and cannot generate long-form text. Text Domain: Trained primarily on written Balochi text; oral dialects or non-standard spelling variants may require additional fine-tuning.

sources.title: GitHub - shah-bakhsh/BalBERT
sources.snippet: 📌 Project Overview BalBERT is the first research-grade Transformer encoder designed specifically for the Balochi language (bal). Developed through continuous Domain-Adaptive Pretraining (DAPT) of xlm-roberta-base on a clean, normalized monolingual corpus of 97,624 Balochi sentences, BalBERT provides a domain-adapted foundation model for all downstream Balochi natural language processing tasks.
